out_of_scope: Incorrect data supplied by third party oracles, except oracle manipulation/flash loan attacks
Impacts requiring basic economic and governance attacks
Attacks requiring leaked keys or credentials
Attacks requiring privileged addresses without additional privilege modification
Impacts relying on external stablecoin depegging not directly caused by a code bug
Secrets or credentials mentioned in GitHub without proof of production use
Impacts on test/configuration files unless explicitly in scope
prohibited_testing: Testing on mainnet or public testnet deployed code
Testing with pricing oracles or third-party smart contracts
Denial of service attacks against project assets
Automated testing that generates significant traffic
Public disclosure of an unpatched vulnerability in an embargoed bounty
known_issue_rule: Previously-discovered bugs listed by the program are not reward eligible; unfixed audit vulnerabilities are not eligible.
notes: Scope is limited to listed addresses/assets, but smart-contract assets are not limited to one chain.
Testing is restricted to local forks of public testnet or mainnet.
Primacy of Impact applies to Smart Contract/Critical; other impacts follow Primacy of Rules.
